title: Frank Drake's Project Ozma
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Frank Drake's Project Ozma, about 1961 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> In 1961, legendary astronomer Frank Drake started project Ozma, the first ever organized search for interstellar radio signals.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 1961 the famous astronomer Frank Drake started Project Ozma, which Michels calls the first organized search for radio signals from other star systems. He tells it as the starting point of science's serious hunt for intelligent life beyond Earth.
